title: Copilot Studio: PPAC Reporting API for Copilot Credit usage data
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap targets and distinguishes them from the documented preview reporting operation. The monthly-limit navigation reaches the correct page but should continue to the agent's limit and Stop usage controls.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans access to Copilot Studio Copilot Credit usage through the Power Platform API.
claims.quote: Power Platform reporting API for Copilot credits provides customers with access to Copilot Credit usage from Copilot Studio through the Power Platform API

claims.claim: The roadmap describes the API as extending existing Power Platform admin center reports.
claims.quote: extending the existing reports available in the Power Platform Admin Center.

claims.claim: Microsoft Learn documents programmatic Copilot Studio usage reporting in public preview.

claims.where: What's changing; controls[0].note; Governance controls; Open questions
claims.claim: Learn does not explicitly identify the documented preview operation as the roadmap's PPAC Reporting API.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" default authentication permissions licensing price; opened Manage Copilot Credits and capacity, Download Copilot Credit usage reports programmatically, and Generate Licensing Report. None explicitly identifies the operation by that roadmap name.

claims.claim: The preview report operation begins with an asynchronous submission.
claims.quote: Report generation is asynchronous. Every client in this tutorial follows the same three steps:

claims.claim: The preview workflow polls the report operation for completion.
claims.quote: Poll the operation until its status is Succeeded or Failed. Follow the polling interval specified by Retry-After.

claims.claim: The preview reporting workflow downloads a gzip-compressed file.
claims.quote: Report retrieval requires delegated administrator authentication and follows an asynchronous workflow: submit a request, poll for completion, and download the gzip-compressed file.

claims.claim: The admin center provides manually triggered consumption report downloads.
claims.quote: Select Download report. Select the download type you need: environment, agent, or user. Download the report.

claims.claim: The tutorial says reporting API data can be combined with other data sources.
claims.quote: Use this data to automate decisions, combine it with other data sources, or maintain a long-term history beyond the 30-day reporting window.

claims.claim: The tutorial describes maintaining a long-term history beyond the 30-day reporting window.
claims.quote: maintain a long-term history beyond the 30-day reporting window.

claims.where: front matter: defaultState; summary; Why it matters
claims.claim: The roadmap API's default state and effects on arrival are not stated.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" default authentication permissions licensing price; "Copilot" "reporting API" "enable" permissions default PPAC. Read the roadmap, capacity guide, reporting tutorial and generate reference; none states an arrival default or automatic behaviour change.

claims.claim: The existing user report can place unauthenticated usage under the all-zero user ID with no user name.
claims.quote: In the user report, usage from sessions where the user didn't sign in, for example on an agent that doesn't require authentication, can appear under the user ID 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000 with no user name.

claims.claim: Roles and prerequisites specifically identified for the roadmap's named API have not been published.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" default authentication permissions licensing price; Power Platform Copilot Studio licensing reports API permissions enable disable cost pricing prerequisites. Opened the reporting tutorial and generate reference; their requirements concern the documented preview.

claims.where: controls[0].note; Risk assessment; Scope; Governance guidance
claims.claim: The documented preview operation requires a Global, Dynamics 365 or Power Platform administrator.
claims.quote: Requires the Global, Dynamics 365, or Power Platform administrator role.

claims.claim: The documented usage reports API supports delegated user authentication only.
claims.quote: The usage reports API supports delegated (user) authentication only

claims.claim: Application-only service principal tokens are not supported by the preview usage reports API.
claims.quote: application-only (service principal) tokens aren't supported.

claims.claim: A script using the documented preview operation uses a signed-in administrator's delegated token.
claims.quote: Create an authentication profile for your tenant and sign in interactively with an account that has one of the required roles.

claims.where: Risk assessment: Security & identity; Open questions
claims.claim: Authentication specifically identified for the roadmap's named API is not yet documented.
claims.quote: Searched: "PPAC Reporting API" default authentication permissions licensing price. Opened the capacity guide, reporting tutorial and Generate Licensing Report; they document delegated authentication for the preview operation without explicitly naming the roadmap API.

claims.where: controls[1].api; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions; Governance guidance
claims.claim: No API for setting the PPAC per-agent monthly consumption limit is documented at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Studio monthly limit API; site:learn.microsoft.com/rest/api/power-platform agent limit; Copilot Studio monthly limit PowerShell Dataverse table; Copilot Studio credit limit table API. Opened the capacity guide and pac copilot-studio reference; found no limit-setting operation.

claims.claim: Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents leads to the page for monthly limits and hard stops.
claims.quote: On the Summary tab, select Manage Agents. The Agents page appears where you can: ... You can set a monthly limit for any agent directly from this page.
claims.fix: Extend controls[1].ui.path and the matching table path to 'Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Manage Agents > agent > Set limit > Stop usage'. Add https://learn.microsoft.com/power-platform/admin/manage-usage-microsoft-copilot-harness to sources; its 'Set a monthly limit for an agent' section documents selecting the agent, Set limit and Stop usage, and states these controls apply across Copilot Studio.

claims.where: controls[1].governs; controls[1].scope; Risk assessment: Autonomy & actions
claims.claim: Administrators can set monthly consumption limits for individual Copilot Studio agents in PPAC.
claims.quote: Admins can set monthly consumption limits for each Copilot Studio agent, regardless of whether the environment uses prepaid capacity or pay-as-you-go billing.

claims.claim: The monthly-limit control has a configurable hard stop that turns the agent off at its limit.
claims.quote: After you set limits, you can configure two key guardrails: ... Hard stop: The agent is automatically turned off once it hits the defined limit.

claims.claim: Limits are not applied instantly and an agent can continue responding after reaching its limit.
claims.quote: Limits aren't applied instantly. An agent can continue to respond for some time after it reaches its limit, so set limits and notification thresholds with some margin.

claims.claim: An agent's monthly limit does not stop agent flows it calls.
claims.quote: An agent's monthly limit doesn't stop the agent flows that the agent calls. Agent flows are billed and checked for capacity separately

claims.claim: Both the tutorial and capacity guide mark programmatic reporting as preview documentation subject to change.
claims.quote: [This article is prerelease documentation and is subject to change.]

claims.claim: Report submissions can return 429 Too Many Requests when service protection is enforced.
claims.quote: Report submissions can return 429 Too Many Requests when service protection is enforced.

claims.claim: The tutorial recommends scheduling reports instead of generating them in a tight loop.
claims.quote: Schedule reports (for example, once a day or once a week) instead of generating them on demand in a tight loop.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.model; licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: An entitlement specifically covering calls to the roadmap's reporting API is not yet published.
claims.quote: Searched: PPAC Reporting API licensing price; Copilot Credit reports API price license. Opened reporting tutorial, generate reference, Assign licenses and manage access, and Licensing for agents powered by the standard harness; found client and authoring requirements, not an API-call entitlement.

claims.claim: No charge or rate specific to calling the PPAC reporting API is published at the time of writing.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Credit reports API price license; Power Platform Copilot Studio licensing reports API cost pricing. Opened the reporting tutorial, generate reference, capacity guide and both cited licensing pages; none publishes a rate or charge per reporting API call.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited authoring requirements page lists a Copilot Studio User License for each standard-harness agent author.
claims.quote: A license for each user, also known as a per user license (or Copilot Studio User License as referred to on the Microsoft 365 admin center). Assign this license to individual users who need access to create and manage agents.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The cited standard-harness authoring requirements page also lists an organisational tenant licence.
claims.quote: A license for your organization, also known as a tenant license (or Copilot Studio as referred to on the Microsoft 365 admin center).

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview lists Copilot Studio authors access as an alternative access configuration.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Copilot Studio authors role in Power Platform admin center.

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview lists a Microsoft 365 Copilot licence as an access route.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Microsoft 365 Copilot license

claims.where: front matter: licensing.notes; Cost and licensing
claims.claim: The licensing overview lists a Copilot Studio trial licence as an access route.
claims.quote: To use Copilot Studio, you need one of the following configurations: ... Copilot Studio trial license.

claims.claim: Neither of the two cited Copilot Studio licensing pages mentions reporting APIs.
claims.quote: Searched: Copilot Credit reports API price license. Opened and read Assign licenses and manage access to Copilot Studio and Licensing for agents powered by the standard harness; neither describes reporting API entitlement.

claims.claim: Copilot Credits are the usage unit shown in the admin center's consumption reporting.
claims.quote: Copilot Credits measure agent usage.

claims.claim: One agent interaction can consume several credits because individual features have their own rates.
claims.quote: One interaction with an agent can consume several credits because each feature the agent uses in that interaction has its own rate.

claims.claim: The tutorial's Copilot Studio workflow client requires sufficient Copilot Credits to run the workflow.
claims.quote: Access to Copilot Studio with permission to create workflows, a Power Platform for Admins V2 connection with an OAuth Connection authentication type, and sufficient Copilot Credits to run the workflow.

claims.claim: The tutorial's Power Automate client requires a Power Automate licence that includes standard connectors.
claims.quote: A Power Automate license that includes standard connectors, and permission to create a Power Platform for Admins V2 connection with an OAuth Connection authentication type.

claims.claim: Sovereign clouds are not currently supported by the documented preview usage reports API.
claims.quote: The usage reports API is in public preview. Sovereign clouds aren't currently supported.

claims.claim: PPAC consumption reports are downloaded through Licensing > Products > Copilot Studio > Summary > Download report.
claims.quote: On the navigation pane, select Licensing. In the Licensing pane, under Products, select Copilot Studio. Select the Summary tab. Select Download report.

claims.claim: The tenant licensing-report generation operation is POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01.
claims.quote: POST https://api.powerplatform.com/copilotstudio/licensing/reports/{ReportName}?api-version=2024-10-01

claims.claim: The reporting request body includes startDate.
claims.quote: startDate | True | string (date) | The inclusive UTC start date of the report range.

claims.claim: The reporting request body includes endDate.
claims.quote: endDate | True | string (date) | The inclusive UTC end date of the report range. Must be on or after the start date.

claims.claim: The reporting request body includes granularity.
claims.quote: granularity | CopilotStudioLicensingReportGranularity | Daily | The granularity of a licensing report.

claims.claim: No configurable control specifically enabling, disabling or restricting callers of the roadmap's named PPAC Reporting API is documented.
claims.quote: Searched: PPAC Reporting API permissions default; Copilot reporting API enable permissions default PPAC; usage reports API access enable. Opened the reporting tutorial, generate reference and capacity guide; found fixed preview role requirements, not a configurable reporting-API switch.

claims.claim: The admin center user report documents user-level consumption for agents powered by the standard harness.
claims.quote: The reports show consumption by environment and agent. For agents powered by the standard harness, the user report also shows consumption by user.
